target_text:
// The read-only K plane view for the score reader k_vnni::qk_group. Internal
  // cache writes take writable views from the block owner instead.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

The first sentence restates the signature (a const bf16 k_vnni_view for one slot and KV head), 'VNNI slots only (Note ...)' restates the requires clause, and 'the AVX-512 reader, one token per lane' describes qk_group, which qk_group's own comment carries. Two facts the code does not say stay: who consumes the view, and why there is no writable form.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // The read-only K plane view for the score reader k_vnni::qk_group. Internal
  // cache writes take writable views from the block owner instead.
```
